title: See your daily money clearly: plan, charges and safety

say: See your daily money clearly: plan, charges and safety.
This is the video for module one of Managing Money in Daily Life.
Two women can earn about the same and live very differently. Often the difference is not income. It is how daily money decisions are made.
Every household has three parts. Money in is everything you receive: salary, sales, payment for a service, or money from family.

say: The step most people skip is the plan. Without it, money is spent in the order requests appear, and the loudest need wins.

say: Here is a worked example. Ngozi is paid about 120,000 naira at the end of each month. She keeps no plan and spends as needs appear.

card.title: Finding the gap days in a salary month

say: In week 1 she spends 48,000 naira. In week 2 she spends 36,000, including shoes for 12,000 that were not planned. In week 3 she spends 28,000.

card.title: Finding the gap days in a salary month

say: That is 112,000 naira gone in three weeks, leaving only 8,000. Week 4 still needs transport and food, so she is about 10,000 short and borrows.
The problem was not low pay. It was front-loading. With a plan, she releases 30,000 naira each week, and the week four gap disappears.

card.title: Finding the gap days in a salary month

say: On one notebook page or in your notes app, write the money you expect this week, and the day it arrives.

say: If the total is too high, reduce wants first, before spending starts, not after you run out.
And plan in weeks. Seven days is short enough to remember and long enough to see a pattern.

say: Cash is accepted almost everywhere and needs no network. But it leaves no record, and it is easy to lose or overspend.

panel.heading: Use each for what it does well
right: Leaves a record you can check

say: Digital money leaves a record and is safer for large sums. But small charges add up, and you must protect your PIN.
Always look before you confirm. Read the fee line on the app screen, and ask the POS agent the charge out loud before the card goes in.

say: Phone safety is money safety. Thieves rarely break into banks. They trick the owner, or take a phone with no lock.
Set a screen lock that is not your birth year, and turn on the lock inside each bank and wallet app.

panel.heading: Lock down your money accounts
items: Screen lock that is not your birth year
Turn on the lock inside each money app
Change easy PINs like 1234 or 0000
WhatsApp two-step verification on
Bank's official number written at home

say: Change any PIN that is easy to guess, like 1234, 0000 or your birthday. Turn on two-step verification in WhatsApp.

say: Write your bank's official customer care number in a notebook at home, so you can block your account fast if your phone is stolen.
No genuine bank, agent or office will ask for your PIN, password or OTP. If anyone asks, end the call. And never trust an SMS alert alone. Check your balance in your own app.

panel.rule: Never share your PIN, password or OTP with anyone.

say: To remember. See your money in, money waiting and money out. Give each naira a job before spending starts. Gap days come from timing, not only low income. Check charges before you confirm. And never share your PIN, password or OTP.
